a, b, n = map(int, input().split())

def my_abs(val):
    return -val if val < 0 else val

min_diff = 1e100
res_x = 0
res_y = 0

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    x = i
    y_upper = int((a / b) * i)
    y_lower = y_upper + 1
    diff_upper = my_abs((a / b) - (y_upper / x))
    diff_lower = my_abs((a / b) - (y_lower / x))
    if min_diff > diff_upper:
        min_diff = diff_upper
        res_x = y_upper
        res_y = x
    if min_diff > diff_lower:
        min_diff = diff_lower
        res_x = y_lower
        res_y = x

print(f"{res_x}/{res_y}")
